program: Eurostars (Eurostars-3) Call 12 - Eureka Network / European Partnership on Innovative SMEs; Danish partner funded by Innovation Fund Denmark (Danmarks Innovationsfond), Dutch partner by RVO; opens 17 Dec 2026, deadline 4 Mar 2027 14:00 CET
stopper_list: No single participant or country may hold more than 70% of the total budget incl. subcontracting; ApS at 780k of 1.0M EUR (78%) is ineligible as planned (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programmes-and-calls/eurostars/eurostars-call-12-for-projects-deadline-march-2027/ ; https://www.eurekanetwork.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/eurostars-eligibility-guidelines.pdf)
SME budget excl. subcontracting at least 50% of total project cost (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programmes-and-calls/eurostars/eurostars-call-12-for-projects-deadline-march-2027/)

Led by an innovative SME; at least two independent entities from at least two Eurostars countries (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programmes-and-calls/eurostars/eurostars-call-12-for-projects-deadline-march-2027/)
Max 36 months and exclusively civil (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programmes-and-calls/eurostars/eurostars-call-12-for-projects-deadline-march-2027/)
At least one participant must receive public funding (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/eurostars-eligibility-guidelines.pdf)

Call opens 17 Dec 2026, deadline 4 Mar 2027 14:00 CET (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programmes-and-calls/eurostars/eurostars-call-12-for-projects-deadline-march-2027/ ; https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/da/soegemuligheder/preannouncement-eurostars-3-call-12/)

IFD request 50,000-300,000 EUR per Danish partner; 500,000 EUR only as total for all Danish partners; requests outside are administratively rejected (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/da/soegemuligheder/preannouncement-eurostars-3-call-12/)

RVO funds the Dutch university hospital only if a Dutch company is in the consortium; otherwise self-funding plus self-funding declaration (https://www.rvo.nl/subsidies-financiering/eurostars ; https://www.eurekanetwork.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/how-to-complete-eurostars-application.pdf)

Danish applicant must be a registered Danish legal entity with CVR (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programmes-and-calls/eurostars/eurostars-call-12-for-projects-deadline-march-2027/ ; https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Guidelines-International-Collaborations-June-2026.pdf)
IFD-funded activities must be carried out in Denmark (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/en/calls/eurostars-international/)
SME per EU definition with signed SME declaration (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programmes-and-calls/eurostars/eurostars-call-12-for-projects-deadline-march-2027/)
Not an undertaking in difficulty (GBER 2(18)); share capital includes share premium (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/No-undertaking-in-difficulty.pdf)
IFD financial criterion: turnover >= 2 MDKK, or >= 500k DKK raised in preceding year, or equity >= 500k DKK (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/en/calls/eurostars-international/)
Demonstrate cash to co-finance own share (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Financial-and-legal-declaration.pdf ; IFD guidelines 2.1)

Every partner must pass the Legal and Financial Viability check; eligibility must hold until the consortium agreement is signed, about 5-6 months (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programmes-and-calls/eurostars/eurostars-call-12-for-projects-deadline-march-2027/ ; https://www.eurekanetwork.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/eurostars-eligibility-guidelines.pdf)
No other public funding for the same activities (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Financial-and-legal-declaration.pdf)

IFD rates and budget rules: SME 75% IR / 50% ED only with effective collaboration or dissemination, else 15 lower; de minimis 60/35% with 300k EUR 3-year cap; 0% overhead; all direct costs in budget; salary/1,642 h max 1,000 DKK; 100% request ineligible (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Guidelines-International-Collaborations-June-2026.pdf)

No subcontracting between partners; subcontracting counts in the 70% test; foreign subcontracting needs IFD pre-approval (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programme-resources/eurostars-frequently-asked-questions/ ; https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/da/soegemuligheder/preannouncement-eurostars-3-call-12/)

PIC for every partner; signed commitment and signature form for every partner plus SME declaration uploaded before the deadline; English only with word limits (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/how-to-complete-eurostars-application.pdf)
Financial annex: report for last full accounting year even if not yet filed (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/how-to-complete-eurostars-application.pdf)

Danish e-grant upload within 14 days of IFD e-mail with No undertaking in difficulty, Financial and legal, and SME declarations (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programmes-and-calls/eurostars/eurostars-call-12-for-projects-deadline-march-2027/ ; IFD guidelines 3.1)

No project start before approval and initial e-grant documents; consortium agreement within six weeks of approval or funding withdrawn (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programme-resources/eurostars-frequently-asked-questions/ ; IFD guidelines 5.1)

Medical projects: clinical trials expected after the project; DE and AT exclude clinical-trial costs; IFD silent, so confirm the prospective study is fundable; market-ready within 24 months after the project (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programme-resources/eurostars-frequently-asked-questions/ ; https://www.ffg.at/en/eurostars-3 ; https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/en/calls/eurostars-international/)
Ethics issues table (question 14) for the clinical study and health data (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/how-to-complete-eurostars-application.pdf)
Expert threshold: at least 3.6 average on each of three criteria (https://www.eurekanetwork.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/how-we-evaluate-eurostars-applications.pdf)
